answer: Each identity anchors to one registered blood donor: the agent donates blood at a clinic under ID, and the registry records it, one body per identity, a vault no script can mint. Each fake costs $120 plus half a day; the 56-day gap means one body serves one identity, and no zephyr-fast form can stand in for a vein, so 100 fakes need 100 bodies, $12,000 and 50 donor-days. Cheapest cheat: paying a stranger $60 to donate under a false name, but the clinic photographs the donor and checks ID, so a mismatch voids the record; the lagoon of bodies stays shallow, and no bulk discount exists.
